NEXT_PERMISSIBLE_ACTION.READINESS_DESCRIBES: under the current evidence, what this workstream is next allowed to do
NEXT_PERMISSIBLE_ACTION.READINESS_DOES_NOT_DESCRIBE: whether this workstream ultimately has a problem
NEXT_PERMISSIBLE_ACTION.DERIVATION_REQUIREMENT: every workstream must mechanically derive NEXT_PERMISSIBLE_ACTION from its assigned READINESS_CLASS before any priority or recommendation use; a NEXT_PERMISSIBLE_ACTION that contradicts the assigned READINESS_CLASS is a hard error
NEXT_PERMISSIBLE_ACTION.READINESS_CLASS_VOCABULARY_UNCHANGED: R4 / R3 / R2 / R1 / R0 only

TARGET_SET_PURPOSE_SEMANTICS.SUPERSEDED_SOLE_GATE: TARGET_SET_MECHANICALLY_DEFINABLE used as the only target-set criterion

HISTORICAL_COMPATIBILITY_FIELD.requirement_if_emitted_after_a005: it may be emitted only together with FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE and SEPARATE_EXECUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE, and it must never assign, promote or downgrade a readiness class by itself

FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE.may_be_defined_by: a stable historical or domain-eligible case set
FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE.frozen_statement: historical domain is mechanically stable can support R3 / FRESH_ATTRIBUTION even when no remediation target exists

SEPARATE_EXECUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE.must_mechanically_define: the current target set that is to be independently authorized for execution now
SEPARATE_EXECUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE.frozen_statement: when the specific mechanism or the current target cannot be stabilized, the value is NO or NOT_ESTABLISHED

READINESS_CLASSIFICATION_RESOLUTION_ORDE.EVALUATION_RULE: evaluate C1 to C5 in order; assign the first class whose gate condition holds; if none of C1 to C5 holds, assign R0 as the C6 fallback
READINESS_CLASSIFICATION_RESOLUTION_ORDE.C1_R0_BLOCKER_CHECK: R0 blocker conditions, reading readiness_rules.R0_applies_when verbatim: parent evidence disproves the proposed defect, or an explicit governance blocker exists, or no admissible evidence exists
READINESS_CLASSIFICATION_RESOLUTION_ORDE.C2_R1_ACTION_SPECIFIC_UPSTREAM_DEPENDENC: an unresolved upstream dependency that explicitly applies to the permissible next action must logically precede it; the action applicability of a dependency is decided only under ACTION_SCOPED_DEPENDENCY below
READINESS_CLASSIFICATION_RESOLUTION_ORDE.C3_R2_EVIDENCE_RECONCILIATION_CHECK: the frozen R2 conditions restated in EVIDENCE_RECONCILIATION_GATE below
READINESS_CLASSIFICATION_RESOLUTION_ORDE.C4_R4_SEPARATE_EXECUTION_GATE_CHECK: R4 holds only when the complete frozen R4 gate set (readiness_rules.R4_requires_all_of, retained verbatim) is satisfied, with its target-set condition resolved under SEPARATE_EXECUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE semantics
READINESS_CLASSIFICATION_RESOLUTION_ORDE.C5_R3_FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_GATE_CHECK: the frozen R3 conditions restated in FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_GATE below
READINESS_CLASSIFICATION_RESOLUTION_ORDE.C6_OTHERWISE_R0_FALLBACK: a workstream matching none of C1 to C5 is classified R0

CO_OCCURRENCE_RESOLUTION_FROZEN.current_defect_established_but_r4_interc: R2 (R4 requires the complete gate; evidence reconciliation or target instability outranks it under C3, and the desirability of R4 must not bypass C3)
CO_OCCURRENCE_RESOLUTION_FROZEN.historical_or_current_ambiguous_with_sta: R3 (even when no separate-execution / remediation target exists)
CO_OCCURRENCE_RESOLUTION_FROZEN.order_used_to_assign_a_class: C1 greater than C2 greater than C3 greater than C4 greater than C5 greater than C6

READINESS_CLASSIFICATION_RESOLUTION_ORDE.P3_READINESS_PRIORITY_ORDER: R4 > R3 > R2 > R1 > R0 (priority_decision_rules P3 and readiness_rules.order_high_to_low, retained unchanged)
READINESS_CLASSIFICATION_RESOLUTION_ORDE.TWO_ORDERS_HAVE_DIFFERENT_PURPOSES: the classification resolution order is a fail-closed assignment device; the readiness priority order is only the P3 desirability order applied after classification; classification must never be chosen by reverting the desirability order

FROZEN_REQUIREMENTS_ALL_OF: current-state attribution stale / changed / ambiguous / not-currently-established
no material source conflict requiring reconciliation
FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_GATE.frozen_statement: R3 does not require a remediation target to be defined

FROZEN_REQUIREMENTS_ANY_OF: no mechanically stable target set for the otherwise permissible next analytical action
case or workstream state requires reconciliation before a valid fresh-attribution target can be formed
EVIDENCE_RECONCILIATION_GATE.frozen_statement: SEPARATE_EXECUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE = NO does not by itself downgrade a lawful R3 into R2; the operative question is whether FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE holds

R4_SEPARATE_EXECUTION_GATE.FROZEN_REQUIREMENTS: readiness_rules.R4_requires_all_of retained verbatim: current unresolved issue mechanically established; latest product state compatible; target set mechanically definable; single primary subsystem identifiable; no unresolved upstream dependency capable of reclassification; no parent governance blocker
R4_SEPARATE_EXECUTION_GATE.TARGET_SET_CONDITION_READING: the R4 target-set condition is resolved under SEPARATE_EXECUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE semantics
R4_SEPARATE_EXECUTION_GATE.INTERCEPTED_R4: a currently established defect that is intercepted at C3 by evidence reconciliation or by target instability is classified R2, not R4

ACTION_SCOPED_DEPENDENCY.BLOCKING_RULE: a dependency may block only the action or actions it explicitly applies to
ACTION_SCOPED_DEPENDENCY.FORBIDDEN_DEFAULT: broad remediation dependency -> block fresh attribution
ACTION_SCOPED_DEPENDENCY.FORBIDDEN_UNLESS: frozen evidence explicitly supports the FRESH_ATTRIBUTION scoping of that edge
ACTION_SCOPED_DEPENDENCY.EDGE_WITHOUT_ESTABLISHED_ACTION_SCOPE: must block no action; it is recorded NOT_ESTABLISHED, or its scope is established only by frozen evidence
ACTION_SCOPED_DEPENDENCY.DEPENDENCY_EDGE_TYPES_UNCHANGED: YES (dependency_rules.allowed_edge_types retained verbatim; APPLIES_TO_ACTION is an additional attribute, not a new edge type)

CITATION_DEPENDENCY_CLARIFICATION.FROZEN_RULE: answer-quality / attribution stabilization precedes broad citation coverage remediation
CITATION_DEPENDENCY_CLARIFICATION.BLOCKING_WS_13_FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRE: independent mechanical evidence that citation attribution itself cannot be validly performed before that upstream workstream
CITATION_DEPENDENCY_CLARIFICATION.OTHERWISE: MUST_PRECEDE for FRESH_ATTRIBUTION must not be established; the edge either stays SEPARATE_EXECUTION scoped or is NOT_ESTABLISHED for FRESH_ATTRIBUTION

CITATION_UPSTREAM_SPECIFICITY.FORBIDDEN: deriving WS-11 MUST_PRECEDE WS-13 from case_exact < target alone
CITATION_UPSTREAM_SPECIFICITY.MUST_PROVE: why WS-11 specifically, rather than WS-09 / WS-10 / overall answer-quality uncertainty
CITATION_UPSTREAM_SPECIFICITY.IF_ONLY_BROAD_ANSWER_QUALITY_INSTABILITY: the specific MUST_PRECEDE edge is NOT_ESTABLISHED; CAN_PRECEDE may be used only when frozen evidence supports it while not constituting a hard dependency

MEASUREMENT_DEPENDENCY_SCOPE.THRESHOLD_UNCHANGED: mechanically established measurement ambiguity capable of changing defect classification for >= 2 candidate workstreams
MEASUREMENT_DEPENDENCY_SCOPE.CURRENT_MEASUREMENT_COEXISTENCE_ON_ONE_P: does not establish a hard dependency
MEASUREMENT_DEPENDENCY_SCOPE.SOURCE: dependency_rules.measurement_precedence retained verbatim; only the action-scope attribute is added

REQUIRED_READINESS_GATE_SCHEMA.APPLIES_TO: the future R3_REDERIVATION_UNDER_AMENDMENT_005 checkpoint; the current R3 harness and tests are not modified by this amendment and are not re-run in this checkpoint

REQUIRED_CONSISTENCY_CONSTRAINTS.NOT_RECOMPUTED_IN_THIS_CHECKPOINT: actual readiness of any workstream is not recomputed here; the following are prospective consistency constraints the R3 rerun must obey
REQUIRED_CONSISTENCY_CONSTRAINTS.HISTORICAL_ONLY_PRODUCT_WORKSTREAM: if the current defect is not established, the historical domain is stable, the fresh-attribution target is stable, and there is no conflict / blocker / dependency, the workstream is R3 even when the separate-execution or remediation target is not defined
REQUIRED_CONSISTENCY_CONSTRAINTS.CURRENT_DEFECT_BUT_MECHANISM_OR_TARGET_U: if the current defect is established but a valid execution target cannot be stabilized and evidence reconciliation is required, the workstream is R2
REQUIRED_CONSISTENCY_CONSTRAINTS.CITATION: if no current citation defect is established, historical case-specific citation evidence exists, the fresh-attribution target is stable, and no attribution-specific upstream dependency is proven, the citation workstream may be R3; it must not become R1 automatically merely because of the broad remediation downstream rule; the concrete result must be determined by the rerun evidence
